html: Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser issued a rare launch statement: Rockstar tried to make GTA 6 "exceed your expectations" and show what games are capable of (GameSpot, GamesRadar). GameSpot also reports superb reviews and huge sales. Reviews.

GTA 6 is already playable in New Zealand (it unlocked at 6 AM ET), and some players are using the region trick to play early. A German streamer says Twitch warned him he could be suspended for streaming it early. The NZ trick explained.
Boxed copies of GTA 6 are a code in a box with no disc, according to Amazon's listings, so everyone downloads the full game. What that means.
Our Short on the fake GTA 6 cheat code lists is live, and the launch guides are now in Spanish too: guías en español.
Cheat codes: still none confirmed. Lists going around are recycled GTA 5 codes. Our cheats tracker.
The Game Awards 2026 nominations: GTA 6 gets 8, including Game of the Year. Lucia's actress, Manni L. Perez, is nominated for Best Performance. Details.
Reviews are reportedly due November 18, the day before launch (not confirmed by Rockstar). The score to beat.
Preload has been live since November 10: the install is up to 212 GB. Out of space?
